description: Links a clinical laboratory test to the anatomy or specimen in which its measurement is taken, as represented by the LOINC System axis.

source_contributions.scope: Laboratory tests with LOINC CLASSTYPE = 1 and status ACTIVE, TRIAL, or DISCOURAGED; DEPRECATED codes are excluded. Tests must also have an identified analyte or disease association; specimen information alone is insufficient for inclusion.
source_contributions.description: System-axis specimen constituents can yield separate anatomy links: for example, Ser/Plas can link to both serum and plasma. Anatomy targets use UBERON identifiers.
